description: The Shatterfrost Spark unleashes a volatile frost burst that chains between up to five targets, ignoring party alignment and piercing through each foe. Every hit applies Frosty Trigger, dealing ::damage damage scaled by .4 magic power and 0.4 weapon damage. The impact knocks targets back 2 tiles, dealing collision damage, then pulls them 2 tile toward the spark as unstable astral frost collapses inward.
name: Shatterfrost Collapse
